title: [CQ-R13c1] Protected launcher runtime marker
definitionOfDone: Under the PROTECTED profile, the selected agent runtime's env carries MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED=1 beside MOE_DAEMON_PATH and MOE_PROXY_PATH. Shown by TerminalAgentLauncherTest.
The legacy path and a Refused selection never add MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED. Shown by tests.
The verification command exits 0 with its output supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.

implementationPlan.description:
TESTS FIRST (red). Load test-driven-development.

1. moe-jetbrains/src/test/kotlin/com/moe/util/RuntimeSelectionPolicyTest.kt holds CQ-R01's protected-selection rows (~440-505).
   - L1: the expected `env` gains "MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED" to "1", so the map is exactly the three keys and every Selected(...) equality includes it. The isWithin loop that keeps runtime paths outside the project must iterate only the two PATH values plus the script, never the marker's '1'.
   - L3: `selected` carries MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED=1. The legacy rows (unconfigured, and executionProfile legacy) still return null, so no marker can come from the selection.
   - L2: each Refused(...) carries no env at all. That is unchanged and stays asserted.
2. moe-jetbrains/src/test/kotlin/com/moe/util/TerminalAgentLauncherTest.kt gets new rendering rows with the protected env:
   - buildWslBashCommandForTest renders MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED='1' unchanged, since toWslPath leaves a non-path value alone, beside the /mnt/ paths;
   - the PowerShell command renders a `$env:MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED` assignment of '1';
   - a row with only the legacy overrides (MOE_DAEMON_PATH and MOE_PROXY_PATH) renders no MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED.
   - resolveAgentEnvOverrides is made internal for this purpose, and a row asserts that its result for BUNDLED, GLOBAL_CONFIG and PROJECT sources never contains the key.
3. Run `cmd.exe /d /c "cd /d D:\projexts\moes\moe-jetbrains && .\gradlew.bat test --rerun"`. The changed L1/L3 rows and the new rendering rows fail; everything else passes.

Error handling in the tests: they assert exact maps and substrings, never message text, and each temporary folder comes from the JUnit rule.

implementationPlan.description:
moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/util/TerminalAgentLauncher.kt:
- Add `internal const val PROTECTED_RUNTIME_MARKER = "MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED"` beside the other launcher constants. Its comment names the contract: set only under the PROTECTED profile; scripts/moe-agent.{sh,ps1} then refuse to fall back from MOE_DAEMON_PATH/MOE_PROXY_PATH (CQ-R13c2).
- In selectProtectedAgentRuntime, after both installed paths are accepted, add `env[PROTECTED_RUNTIME_MARKER] = "1"` before `return ProtectedAgentRuntime.Selected(script, env)`. A Refused return never reaches it.
- resolveAgentEnvOverrides changes from private to internal, for the legacy test only. Its behavior is unchanged, and it never adds the marker.
- Every agent launch takes its env from resolveContext's `selected?.env ?: resolveAgentEnvOverrides(...)`, so this one insertion covers every role, team and WSL launch. Do not touch any other path.

Error handling: unchanged. A missing installed artifact is still Refused, with its fixed reason.

VERIFY ONCE, fresh.

1. Run `cmd.exe /d /c "cd /d D:\projexts\moes\moe-jetbrains && .\gradlew.bat test --rerun"`. That is cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test; this WSL host has no Linux JDK. It must exit 0. Record the per-class counts from build/test-results/test/TEST-*.xml, as CQ-R01's evidence did. The fresh command, exit code and output tail are complete_task's verification evidence.
2. `git diff --check` over the three files is clean.
3. A read-only `git status --short` shows that only those three files changed. Never revert, stash, `git add -A` or commit a peer's or pre-existing dirty path.

Error handling: fix a failing row in code, never by loosening an equality.

implementationPlan.description:
ADVERSARIAL SELF-REVIEW, once, as the final step. Load adversarial-self-review. Read the three-file diff as an attacker:
- Can the marker reach a legacy launch? It must come only from Selected. If the IDE's own process environment carries MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED, a legacy wrapper would refuse its fallback; that fails closed, so note it in the constant's comment and do not strip it.
- Does any launch path bypass resolveContext's env and so miss the marker under PROTECTED? Look for team launches, governor/architect TUIs and WSL launches.
- Is the value rendered exactly '1' in bash, WSL bash and PowerShell? toWslPath must never rewrite it.
- Did loosening the visibility of resolveAgentEnvOverrides change any behavior?
- Would I be embarrassed if this shipped?
Fix any finding, then re-run step 3's command fresh before complete_task.
implementationPlan.note: Self-review found no defects. Only selectProtectedAgentRuntime's Selected path sets the marker. All launches (the two callers at lines 323 and 353) take env from resolveContext's `selected?.env ?: resolveAgentEnvOverrides`. The value is a fixed "1", and toWslPath leaves a non-drive value unchanged (tested). The inherited-IDE-env caveat is documented in the constant's comment. The internal visibility change has no behavior effect. No code changed after the green Gradle run.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
- The wrappers detecting 'protected' by themselves, from project.json or their own install location: rejected. project.json is repository-controlled, which is exactly R01 follow-up 2's attack, and the installed root has no marker. Only the launcher, after RuntimeSelectionPolicy.profile() == PROTECTED, knows the session is protected.
- Failing closed in the wrappers whenever MOE_PROXY_PATH is set but missing: rejected, because it changes legacy behavior (epic rail: preserve legacy).
- Putting the marker in resolveAgentEnvOverrides: rejected. That is the legacy path.
planningNotes.risks:
- L1's exact env equality must be updated, and its isWithin loop must skip the marker's non-path value.
- R01's size rail limits only R01's own landed slice; this is a new row.
- Gradle runs through cmd.exe from WSL, as R01's verification did; build output lands under moe-jetbrains/build, which is ignored.
- The CQ-R13c2 wrapper contract is the exact value '1'. Any other value is legacy.
